trial_title: Efficacy of Two Temozolomide Regimens in Adjuvant Treatment of Patients With Brain High Grade Glioma
brief_summary: This is a phase III, non-blinded, blocked randomized clinical trial. The study is conducted on 62 newly diagnosed patients with brain glioblastoma multiforme and anaplastic astrocytoma referring to the oncology clinics during March 2018 and March 2019. The patients will be randomized to 6-cycle and 12-cycle adjuvant Temozolomide groups using block randomization method (1:1).

eligibility_table.criterion: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma and anaplastic astrocytoma
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has anaplastic astrocytoma, which is included in the eligibility criteria.
The patient is 45 years old, which falls within the age range of 18 to 70 years.

eligibility_table.criterion: Karnofsky Performance Scale Index equal or more than 60 percent
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a Karnofsky Performance Scale Index score of ≥60%?

eligibility_table.justification: Assuming the patient has signed informed consent as part of the trial process.
The patient's chronic pain and treatment history may suggest potential hepatic issues, but no specific lab values are provided to confirm chronic hepatic conditions.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a chronic hepatic condition defined as a liver disease lasting more than 6 months, with documented liver function tests indicating elevated liver enzymes (AST/ALT > 40 U/L) or bilirubin levels > 1.2 mg/dL?

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced a serum creatinine level ≥1.5 mg/dL at any point during the treatment regimen?
